scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build:api && pnpm build:web && pnpm build:tauri
scripts.build:api: cd apps/api && bun build --compile --target bun-windows-x64 --outfile ../desktop/src-tauri/binaries/mikumon-api-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe src/index.ts
scripts.build:tauri: node -e "require('fs').cpSync('packages/db/migrations','apps/desktop/src-tauri/migrations',{recursive:true,force:true})" && cd apps/desktop/src-tauri && cargo tauri build
